category: serverless inference, card-backed pay-as-you-go with a promo credit

free_tier.stated: no standing free allowance on the Starter Plan, which is pay-as-you-go. A promotional credit of USD 25 for Token Factory (and USD 25 of Tavily credit) is issued through the Nebius Builder Program and expires 90 days after issue; applying a promo code is done in the console after a billing account with a bank card exists
free_tier.notes: the credit is drawn down by per-token prices that depend on the model; the Builder Program page was last modified September 2026

retention.stated: the plans page lists 'Zero-retention inference.' for the Starter Plan; the supplemental terms separately allow storing input and output unless the customer opts out in the onboarding form or by email to support, and which of the two is the default is…

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API at https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/ (the console home page also shows a regional host, api.tokenfactory.us-central1.nebius.com)
tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client pointed at the base URL with an API key created in the console; model ids are vendor/model, for example deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528
chaining: the Builder Program credit is the only free lane found; the card on file means usage beyond the credit is billed pay-as-you-go

limits.value: Starter Plan baseline of 400K TPM and 600 RPM on the plans page (the rate-limits page example table prints 60 RPM and 400,000 TPM as its baseline); the limit rises x1.2 for the next 15-minute window at 80 per cent or more average use, falls by 1.5 at 50 per cent or less, up to 20 times the base; HTTP 429 above the limit
USD 25 of Token Factory promo credit from the Builder Program, expiring 90 days after issue; the account can be auto-paused when monthly consumption exceeds the credit by more than 30 per cent

identity_cost.detail: sign-in with a Google or GitHub account, then a billing account with a bank card is mandatory to finish onboarding ('Billing setup is mandatory—you cannot complete onboarding without it.'); bank transfer is for companies only. The Builder Program form separately asks for name, email, company or university name, role, country and a description of what is being built, with a verified email. A Nebius Cloud Support answer relayed on a hackathon forum says promotional-credit-only access is unavailable

reliability_note: Best-effort 99% availability on the Starter Plan and no SLA for the service; free credits may be modified or revoked without notice; a failed card charge suspends the account; sudden bursts may be throttled with HTTP 429
confidence_note: every field is quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-03; the card requirement is also relayed by a third-party forum post; unverified: whether a promo code redeems without a card, and the per-model rate limits
